snippet.title: Artificial Fashionista Trailer
snippet.description:
Artificial Fashionista is a light-hearted dress-up game with lots of characters to meet and clothes to collect!

🎁 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924880/Artificial_Fashionista/
👠 Play on Itch.io: https://kigyo.itch.io/artificial-fashionista

👋 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S

👠 Premise:
Foris is a social media influencer that finds herself in a somewhat unique situation: She's stuck in a death game with 13 criminals!

On a whim, she was given a rare opportunity, though: She can redeem herself by completing her captor's fashion challenges!

Help Foris sweet-talk the other participants into giving her more clothes, put together fashionable outfits, and impress her hosts — for a chance to regain access to the outside world!
